root_cause: During integration of BFF-DEAD-ADMISSION-PIPELINE-REMOVAL-001, PR #6021 was approved by reviewer Codex at exact head 909c4524724dc96b41e77c5c25409d273115143d on branch task/BFF-DEAD-ADMISSION-PIPELINE-REMOVAL-001-v2. However, auto_integrator.py::fetch_refs only fetched candidate.target_branch and f'+refs/heads/{candidate.branch}:refs/remotes/origin/{candidate.branch}' where candidate.branch was defaulted to task/BFF-DEAD-ADMISSION-PIPELINE-REMOVAL-001. Neither the replacement branch task/BFF-DEAD-ADMISSION-PIPELINE-REMOVAL-001-v2 nor the exact head commit 909c4524724dc96b41e77c5c25409d273115143d was fetched into the local repository. Consequently, in run_rebase_smoke, git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/dev 909c4524724dc96b41e77c5c25409d273115143d failed (exit 128: fatal: invalid reference), falling through to git worktree add --detach <tmp> 909c4524724dc96b41e77c5c25409d273115143d, which raised CommandFailure and triggered a smoke-failed unblock task.
resolution: Updated scripts/git/auto_integrator.py so fetch_refs and run_rebase_smoke accept head_branch and exact_head. fetch_refs now explicitly fetches all candidate/bound/PR head branches as well as exact_head commit directly from origin via git fetch origin <exact_head>. In integrate_candidate, head_branch=str(pr.get('headRefName') or '') or candidate.branch is passed to run_rebase_smoke. PR #6021 remains open, valid, and review-approved at head 909c4524724dc96b41e77c5c25409d273115143d with all CI execution checks green; with this fix, auto-integrator fetches the required head refs and commit objects so that smoke testing and final merge can proceed without becoming stranded.
code_change: scripts/git/auto_integrator.py: fetch_refs and run_rebase_smoke updated to accept head_branch and exact_head, ensuring replacement branch refs and approved exact-head commits are fetched from origin prior to git merge-base and detached worktree execution.
